lead: Leave the city and discover the landscapes, history and nature that surround Valencia: underground caves, hot springs, Roman and medieval towns, and wineries among the vineyards.
With transport included, an official guide and online booking at visitvalencia.com.

items.title: Excursion to the Caves of San José
items.subtitle: Transport included · Guide · 10% off with VTC · Rated 5/5 · La Vall d’Uixó · Castellón
items.body: The Caves of San José, in La Vall d’Uixó (Castellón), are home to the longest navigable underground river in Europe. During the excursion, a boat travels the channels and galleries carved into the limestone for several hundred metres, with stalactite and stalagmite formations that create a unique and unrepeatable underground landscape. The excursion includes return transport from Valencia, departing at 08:15 every day of the year, and lasts about 4 hours in total. One of the most highly rated departures, with a perfect 5/5 score.

items.title: Montanejos: hot springs and Salto de la Novia
items.subtitle: Hot springs at 25 °C · Waterfalls · Nature · 10% off with VTC · Inland Castellón
items.body: Montanejos is one of the most spectacular nature destinations in the Comunitat Valenciana. The Fuente de los Baños offers hot springs that gush out at 25 °C all year round, creating a natural pool in which to bathe among the rocks of the Mijares river. The Salto de la Novia is a waterfall of great beauty a few minutes from the village. The excursion lasts a full 8 hours with return transport from Valencia, departing Monday to Friday at 09:00. A full day of nature, water and mountains just 90 km from Valencia.

items.title: Sagunto: the city of the Roman Empire
items.subtitle: Roman Theatre · Moorish castle · Medieval Jewish quarter · 10% off with VTC · 28 km from Valencia
items.body: Sagunto is one of the most history-laden cities in all of Spain. Its inhabitants preferred death to surrendering to Hannibal in 219 BC. Today it preserves a spectacular Roman Theatre, one of the best preserved on the Peninsula, and a Moorish castle that dominates the plain with views from the sea to the mountains of the interior. The medieval Jewish quarter and the old town complete a visit that spans more than 2,000 years of history in barely 4 hours. Departs on Saturdays at 08:30 with transport included.

items.title: Peñíscola: Game of Thrones and medieval stories
items.subtitle: Papa Luna Castle · Game of Thrones · Walled city · 10% off with VTC · Costa Azahar
items.body: Peñíscola is one of the most impressive medieval towns in Spain and a filming location for Game of Thrones. The walled city rises on a volcanic rock surrounded by the Mediterranean, dominated by the Castle of Papa Luna, where Pope Benedict XIII lived during the Western Schism. The excursion lasts between 8 and 9 hours and includes return transport. It departs Tuesday to Saturday at 09:00. A unique combination of medieval history, spectacular coastal scenery and popular culture.

items.title: Utiel-Requena: winery tasting, cultural visit and lunch
items.subtitle: D.O. Utiel-Requena wine tasting · Medieval town · Lunch included · Historic winery
items.body: The Utiel-Requena region is the main wine-growing area of the Comunitat Valenciana, with the D.O. Utiel-Requena internationally recognised for its Bobal wines. The 7-hour excursion includes return transport from Valencia, a guided visit to the town of Requena with its medieval historic centre and underground wineries, a wine tasting at a winery and lunch included. Available every day with a guide in Spanish and English. The most complete wine tourism experience from Valencia.

blocks.title: Tips for choosing your excursion from Valencia
items: If you only have half a day free, the excursions to the Caves of San José (4 h) or Sagunto (4 h) are the best option, with very early departures so you can make the most of the rest of the day in Valencia
For a full day of nature, Montanejos is the most highly rated excursion: the hot springs of the Mijares river at 25 °C all year round are a unique experience just 90 km from Valencia
Peñíscola is the most visually spectacular excursion: the walled city above the sea deserves to be photographed from every angle, especially at sunrise before the groups arrive
The Utiel-Requena excursion includes lunch and wine tasting: it is the most expensive but also the most complete, perfect for those looking for a food and cultural experience in a single day
With the Valencia Tourist Card you get 10% off most excursions: always buy online at visitvalencia.com for the cheapest price
Book at least 24–48 hours ahead in high season: some excursions have limited places and sell out, especially the Caves of San José and Peñíscola in summer
